# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion RISCV_PICO_2_3_1_0)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if(EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD waveshare_rp2350_tiny CACHE STRING "Board type")

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)
include(pico_extras_import.cmake)
project(travel-companion C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
pico_sdk_init()

add_library(board_config INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(board_config INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/config)

# Public key of the log recipient, generated by: python3 tools/tclog.py keygen
if(NOT EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/config/log_pubkey.h)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "config/log_pubkey.h is missing - run 'python3 tools/tclog.py keygen' in the project root first")
endif()

add_subdirectory(drivers)
add_subdirectory(lib)
add_subdirectory(src)

add_executable(travel-companion src/main.c)
target_link_libraries(travel-companion app)

pico_enable_stdio_usb(travel-companion 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(travel-companion 0)
pico_add_extra_outputs(travel-companion)
